clue.text: Tweeted, like a wagtail quietly absorbed

indicators.note: the wagtail word takes the quiet letter into its middle, as a sponge soaks something up

parts.note: the pied wagtail is a black-and-white bird, so pied means coloured like it
P is piano, the musical direction to play quietly

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher notes that a wagtail sang softly while taking something in.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds that pipe make a thin high call, a synonym for tweeting.

clue.text: Harry's turn to find base for craftsman

parts.note: Harry Potter, the boy wizard, so Harry's gives Potter's
a wheel is a turn, as in a wheel of the dancers

explanation.surface: The boy wizard takes his turn to search for a craftsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceramicist shapes clay on a revolving disc, the base of the craft.

clue.text: Fish with spots caught nearer the bottom, maybe

parts.note: a perch is a freshwater fish

indicators.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught, and that letter shifts lower in the spots word in this down clue

parts.note: acne is a skin condition of spots

explanation.surface: An angler hooks a spotted fish near the riverbed, possibly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught nearer the bottom' moves the C down one place in ACNE to give ANCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Perchance is an old-fashioned synonym for perhaps.

clue.text: Fancy doctor on trial blowing kiss

indicators.note: in a down clue, the doctor sits on top of what follows
blowing a kiss sends it away, so the kiss letter is removed

parts.note: an exam is a trial or test
X is the conventional sign for a kiss

explanation.surface: A doctor in court blows a kiss to someone he fancies.
explanation.definitionFit: Fancy as a noun is an imagined notion, like a dream or daydream.

clue.text: Whole global organisation not working

parts.note: UN, the United Nations
a broken machine is not working

explanation.surface: A complaint that the entire United Nations has stopped functioning.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unbroken is intact, so whole is a synonym.

clue.text: Capital case worker gets control

parts.note: capital letters are upper case
a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: A worker in a capital-punishment case gains authority.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the upper hand means holding the advantage or dominance.

clue.text: Beastly sound from noted vicar's abode

definitions.meaning: the harsh cry a donkey makes
the Vicar of ..., in the song, kept his Berkshire parish by changing religion with each monarch

explanation.surface: A donkey's noise is heard from a famous clergyman's house.
explanation.definitionFit: A donkey's call is its bray, and Bray is the village in the old English song about a turncoat vicar.

clue.text: Tirades from Brutus, lost without Latin for translation

indicators.note: translating turns words into a new form, so these letters are rearranged
without means lacking, so the Latin letter is dropped

explanation.surface: Rants from Brutus, who is stuck without Latin to translate.
explanation.walkthrough: BRUTUS LOST loses L ('without') to leave BRUTUSOST, rearranged by 'for translation'.
explanation.definitionFit: Outbursts are sudden angry speeches, so they are synonyms of tirades.

clue.text: Hazard hampering Leander's first return to see Hero

indicators.note: return sends the assembled letters back, so they read upwards
the leading letter gets inside the dice word and hampers it

parts.note: hazard is an old game played with dice; to dice is to gamble

indicators.note: first means the opening letter of the Leander word

explanation.surface: Greek myth: danger stops Leander's swim back to his lover Hero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hero' is not Leander's lover but a hero: the Spanish warrior El Cid. DICE takes L to give DICLE, read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: El Cid was the medieval Castilian warlord celebrated as a national hero of Spain.

clue.text: Surgery on butt when shots may go astray?

indicators.note: in this across clue, the surgery word is placed on after the butt word, following it

parts.note: a butt is a target, as in the butt of a joke or an archery butt
a doctor's surgery is also called a practice

explanation.surface: An absurd image of an operation on someone's bottom, where things may go wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'butt' suggests a backside and 'shots' injections, but it is the target and the shots are fired at it.
explanation.definitionFit: Shooting practice at a target is exactly when beginners' shots miss, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Eg lairds arrived gradually, going from left to right

parts.note: landed means arrived, as a plane does

indicators.note: the left letter L changes into the right letter R

parts.note: gently means gradually, a little at a time

explanation.surface: Scottish lords turned up slowly, moving across the room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going from left to right' swaps L (left) for R (right) in GENTLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Lairds, Scottish estate owners, are examples of the class that owns country land.

clue.text: Flipping hard exercises: Nutmeg's in time and they don't last long

indicators.note: flipping turns the hard and exercises letters over, so they read backwards

parts.note: H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
PE, physical education

indicators.note: the setter's pronoun sits in the time word

parts.note: an era is a period of time
Nutmeg is the setter, so Nutmeg's (Nutmeg is) gives ME

explanation.surface: A setter complains that tough workouts squeezed into the time available never last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flipping' reverses HPE to EPH. 'Nutmeg's' is the setter speaking: Nutmeg is ME, the usual crossword self-reference.
explanation.definitionFit: Ephemera are short-lived things, like mayflies or yesterday's papers.

clue.text: Sign of new life had excited man of faith

parts.note: a bud on a plant shows new growth

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Seeing spring buds thrilled a religious man.
explanation.definitionFit: The Buddha, founder of Buddhism, is a supreme religious figure.

clue.text: Roughly clean son, to accompaniment of cursing

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
and means together with, accompanying
blast is an oath uttered when cursing

explanation.surface: A parent scrubs their son roughly while swearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandblasting cleans a surface by spraying it with abrasive grit, a rough cleaning.

clue.text: Every woman's put up with clothing habits at the seaside

indicators.note: the put-up-with word clothes, wraps round, the other letters

parts.note: to bear something is to tolerate it
each means every
W is the abbreviation for woman; the 's is woman is

explanation.surface: Everyone puts up with a woman's beach-dress habits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'habits' means clothes, as a nun's habit, not routines.
explanation.definitionFit: Swimsuits and sandals are garments worn on the beach, the habits here meaning clothing.

clue.text: Note penned by leading faction for minimal circulation

parts.note: top means leading, foremost

indicators.note: the note is shut inside the faction word as in a pen

parts.note: a sect is a faction or splinter group
RE is the second note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A memo written by the dominant faction is not to be shared widely.
explanation.definitionFit: Classified documents are shown to as few people as possible, so they circulate minimally.

clue.text: Nice tasting bit of pork's spoken about

indicators.note: the spoken word goes about, around, the pork letter

parts.note: said means spoken

indicators.note: a bit of the word pork's is just its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone talks about how good a piece of pork tastes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoken' tempts a homophone, but it is SAID.
explanation.definitionFit: Sapid is a rare word for flavoursome, having an agreeable taste.

clue.text: Make a start on horse, astride it with child behind

indicators.note: the horse sits astride, with legs either side of, the inner letters

parts.note: a pinto is a piebald horse

indicators.note: the child letters come behind the it letters

explanation.surface: Getting onto a horse with a child sitting behind.
explanation.definitionFit: To pitch into a task is to set about it vigorously.

clue.text: Bird nipping tail of margay (a carnivore)

indicators.note: the hen holds the tail letter between its jaws, as if nipping it

parts.note: a hen is a bird

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A bird pecks at the tail of a margay, a wild cat.
explanation.walkthrough: A margay is a small South American wild cat.
explanation.definitionFit: The hyena is a meat-eating mammal, an example of a carnivore.

clue.text: Saved, having sworn to limit sex

indicators.note: the sworn word encloses and so limits the sex word

parts.note: deposed means testified under oath
IT is an old slang word for sex appeal or sex

explanation.surface: Someone pledges celibacy and calls themselves redeemed.
explanation.definitionFit: Money deposited in a bank has been put by, a synonym for saved.

clue.text: Prophet seen in chapel is harmless

indicators.note: the letters can be seen running inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A worshipper observes that a prophet glimpsed in chapel poses no threat.
explanation.definitionFit: Elisha was a Hebrew prophet, the successor of Elijah in the Bible.

clue.text: Operating without losing initial energy

indicators.note: the without word loses its first letter

parts.note: minus means without, as in minus his coat
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Something keeps running without running out of its starting power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is not a container signal but a synonym: MINUS loses M.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that is operating is currently being used.

clue.text: Misdirected letters from a schemer I don't know

indicators.note: misdirected letters are sent in the wrong order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A recipient of a schemer's wrongly addressed mail disclaims knowledge of it.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is a casual shrug meaning one has no idea.

clue.text: Bread, a status symbol for the rich?

definitions.text: a status symbol for the rich?
definitions.meaning: a ...-Royce car, a luxury marque, shortened

explanation.surface: Is bread a sign of wealth?
explanation.definitionFit: Bread rolls are small loaves, and a Rolls, short for Rolls-Royce, is a luxury car flaunted by the wealthy.

clue.text: Cardinal has predecessor cast in iron

indicators.note: the predecessor is cast, set, inside the iron like metal in a mould

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
the number before the cardinal sought, four, written in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A cardinal's forerunner is portrayed in an iron casting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cardinal' suggests a churchman but means a cardinal number.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinal numbers are the counting numbers, of which this is one.

clue.text: Rogue star people ruin Mars, for one

indicators.note: rogue means behaving out of order, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Science fiction: renegade stellar beings wreck the Red Planet.
explanation.definitionFit: A superior planet orbits beyond Earth, and Mars is the nearest example.

clue.text: Ram caught in rain most thoroughly whacked

indicators.note: the ram word is trapped inside the rain word

parts.note: wet as a noun means rainy weather
Aries is the zodiac sign of the ram

explanation.surface: A sheep stuck in a downpour is utterly exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: Whacked is slang for tired, so the superlative means most exhausted.

clue.text: Unproductive end to talks Blair pursues

indicators.note: the Blair name chases, so comes after, the end of talks
the end of a word is its final letter

parts.note: Tony Blair, former UK prime minister

explanation.surface: Fruitless negotiations end, and the Prime Minister keeps pressing on.
explanation.definitionFit: Stony ground yields nothing, so the word means barren or unfruitful.
